title: Seal eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M56 56 Q60 60 66 56' stroke='#1a3a52' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
